title: Team statement that limestone absorbs the signal from the known Khafre chambers

tellings.quote: This is because the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal.

plain: In 2025, the team behind a radar scan of the Khafre pyramid at Giza in Egypt said in a statement on their Facebook page that the pyramid's known chambers do not show up clearly because they sit inside a limestone slab that absorbs the signal. In the statement's words, "the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal." The researcher Jeffrey Drum reads it out on Michels' show, crediting the team members Armando and Filippo Biondi, as their answer to critics of the scan, which they say found structures beneath the pyramids.
